# Solution blocks

What is Colin's opportunity cost of producing one cake? Of one pasty?

::: solution

*1C:* $4$ pasties. *1P:* $\frac{1}{4}$ cake.

A full day is $20P$ or $5C$, so $5C = 20P$ and $1C = 4P$: one cake costs four pasties.

:::

The attribute form reads the same as the bare class.

::: {.solution}

The two opportunity costs are always reciprocals.

:::
